resources.string: Oh, what I wouldn't do to have our talismans back!
I heard you helped out around Grivaros during the attack. I do hate to impose, but we need your help again!
Imagine cream puffs flavored with oysters and rosemary rat tartlets…!
Excuse me! Are you perchance going into that dreadful cellar ahead?
I'm really more of an artist than a chef. Imagine airy cream puffs flavored with a hint of oyster and rosemary rat tongue tartlets...
I do hope you have what I required. The patrons are getting impatient. I don't know how much longer I can delay them.
Magnificent! Such firmness. Such plumpness. Such juiciness. Why, it will only be a moment and I will have the hors d'oeuvres read for you to place on the tables.
"I have the tongues."
You found them! Unngh. This one looks as if it's been… chewed on? In any case, thank you so much for your help. I can't wait to hang these back up in the window.
Isn't it magnificent? I could spend all day simply admiring the splendor of the ancient builders.
You look like the enterprising sort who also happens to be striding with a purpose toward the ruins below. Can I trouble you with a request?
These artifacts should be kept safe in a private collection. I'd hate to see them down there in those filthy— I mean magnificent ruins, collecting dust.
Mind where you rest your eyes, traveler. This is not a safe place.
You there. Step closer. Keep your voice low.
I am grateful to you, but you should not associate with us any longer. We cannot take the risk.
Time to show your quality and assure our foothold in these lands! Squash our enemies like bugs!
Time to show your quality and assure our foothold in these lands! Squash our enemies like bugs!
Mind your little experiments don't plant you on the wrong side of this conflict, eh?
Try not to get distracted by all the books. There is work to be done.
So many mysteries here. So much power for the taking, I can hardly contain myself.
So many mysteries here. So much power for the taking, I can hardly contain myself.
Brute force will only get you so far in this land. We look forward to watching you struggle to grasp the true wealth of Nighthaven.
Mind your navel gazing, acolyte -- lest you trip over your ego on the way out.
Humans, Berlaur, and Upyr. Such innate conflict between them. Perhaps the Covenant's wisdom can prevail here.
Humans, Berlaur, and Upyr. Such innate conflict between them. Perhaps the Covenant's wisdom can prevail here.
Cooler heads will prevail, little Adventurer. Be careful where you swing your weapon.
Meddling in forces best left untouched may not give you the best results. Be careful.
Welcome to Tularest. Do you require a place to… rest?
Don't worry, you can sleep late, no need to be up with the dawn here, even if I am!
Too many graves in Nighthaven. Too many! It's glorious! But my arms are going to drop off. I can't keep digging. I must keep digging!
Too many graves in Nighthaven. Too many! It's glorious! But my arms are going to drop off. I can't keep digging. I must keep digging!
The Builder King was an exquisite architect! But not very legible. Amazing style, however! Look at that odd shape there! And this one that resembles a food stain! Brilliant!
[It feels like it's watching you and wants desperately to be your truest friend and give you all the best things in life and go on the greatest adventure that will never, ever end.]
Is that a kind heart I sense down there? Hello, can you see me? I am far above you and so very, very small.
[It's just a doll.]
Nighthaven has secrets within secrets, if you know where to look.
Oh, hello Soulwarden. I've been waiting to meet you.
Soulwarden, I imagine these fragments were not easy to find, but...
We've come so far, but there are still more fragments to be found in the darkest corners of Nighthaven.
Ah, you return. Triumphantly, perhaps?
"I believe I have found them all."
Why... yes. YES! I think you have! I feel... relief. Clarity.
"What should we do with them now?"
I think we've done all that we need to. I believe the voice who wanted these -- who needed these -- is whole again. Or as close to whole as they can be.
"I would like to speak with them."
They would like to speak with you as well. They're in a secluded place, not far from here. Lend me your map, I'll mark where they are.
"What about you, then?"
Me? I don't know! I feel a weight off of me, but I can't explain why... For now, I will enjoy the relief, then... who knows? Perhaps I'll return to my studies.
I will need to refamiliarize myself with Nighthaven. Much has changed since I once walked these lands.
Such a ponderous affliction that created the Berlaur.
"Have you been studying it?"
Aye, I have.
"And?"
I have learned so much and so little- namely that I need to rethink my strategy of choosing apprentices.
Ah, you there! Spare a moment, if you would please?
Poor Ejnar, the boy was always foolhardy. Sounds like he took it upon himself to try and contain the outbreak at Piatra Antica. Go there and convince him to come back, will you?
"What can I do?"
Well, our protective talismans went missing in the siege! Those talismans are made from a special black garlic that wards off evil.
What's that look? Of course they work! How could hundreds of years of tradition be wrong?
Who knows when the Berlaur will return to finish the job? Please, how can we protect ourselves without garlic?
Complete the Quest
You found them! Unngh. This one looks as if it's been… chewed on? In any case, thank you so much for your help. I can't wait to hang these back up in the window.
"I'm here to fetch the wine."
Ah, so you are! Marvelous! Simply marvelous. I was wondering, since you are already going into such a place, would you be willing to collect something for me?
We don’t have enough hors d'oeuvres for the party, and if there isn't something on the tables, the nobles will be so displeased. Not that they’d eat them.
They aren't picky, it just has to look like something someone would eat. Which is why I require plump rat tongues for my masterpiece.
Those rats aren't going to lose their tongues on their own!
Complete the Quest
Splendid! Everything is on the tables, and I get to keep my head for another day. Truly, you are a lifesaver!
"What's wrong?"
They do not yet know it, but I have fallen out of the thrall of our liegelord. The things I have seen... I would run, if there were not so many others I would leave behind.
"What do you mean by 'out of thrall'?"
On a whim the Upyr possess the ability to weaponize our minds against us and force us to do their bidding.
"How can I help?"
I cannot run inside without risking my sanity once more, but you... I do not know why, but you seem to possess a special fortitude. Will you enter and rescue my fellows in bondage?
"I will see what I can do."
Thank you. I will wait here. You may be attacked... just know that none of us will take umbrage with you defending yourself.
If you have not seen the horrors within, I beg you: keep going.
Complete the Quest
You seem composed. Perhaps with some small satisfaction?
"I dealt with Lord Bathory."
Strangely, I believe you. I hope you were able to save a few of us.
"I did. Hopefully they stay free."
Indeed. Take my gratitude and a small token of my appreciation. We may not mean much to our lords, but we servants shall never forget your deeds.
"Uh... sure?"
You see, I am an antiquarian of sorts. I specialize in the responsible reclamation of items of intellectual interest from ancient ruins.
"Responsible how?"
Well, I simply ensure that no harm comes to the ruins in the process of liberating artifacts for preservation and educational purposes. It's really an important job!
"Uh huh."
I also make sure to tread lightly around the remaining ah... denizens... who may not be keen on visitors.
"So what do you need me for?"
Well, I need you to venture into the so-named Hall of the South King and recover some artifacts I neglected to carry with me on my last expedition.
"Why did you leave them behind?"
Scary skeletons.
"Scary… skeletons?"
Scary skeletons! Could you do me a favor and help them find eternal rest while you are in there? They seemed pretty tired!
"That doesn't sound very respectful."
Why it's the MOST respectful action to take. For myself and future antiquarians. And the denizens. Them first, naturally.

Now, don't you worry about me. I'll be safe right here where there are no scary skeletons -- I assure you. Just focus on recovering those relics of moderate monetary value and everything will be fine!
Did you find my stol— I mean, those precious artifacts I mentioned? I'm afraid I have nothing to offer you without them.
Complete the Quest
The suspense is killing me! So much of value in those ruins. It would be a shame for it all to go to waste…
"I'm not entirely sure this is for research…"
What an odd thing to say. Museums would drool over the honor of signing a contract with a private collector in order to display these priceless antiques for all to see!
"For coin."
Well, coin does make future expeditions possible. It all feeds into itself.
"Well that isn't suspicious. Here. Take."
And you shall be justly compensated! Thank you for contributing to our ever expanding horde of ancient— uh, knowledge…
"I can. Are you in distress?"
I am in such distress. The inhabitants of the Grand Carnival shun me for a crime I did not commit. Once upon a time, the Fortune Mother warred against the bunnies.
"'Bunnies' as in 'rabbits'?"
Rabbit King was her sworn enemy. But I brokered a truce at much risk to myself. Then, one night in secret, someone destroyed the symbol of that treaty. And I was punished.
Perhaps you can seek out evidence of treason and exonerate me. You will go? Thank you! On your journey, you won't hear from me, but you will see from me.
"What exactly does that mean?"
Shhhhh! It will be OUR SECRET.
I am so small and helpless. I miss my friends and my home.
Complete the Quest
Is the truce established once more? Will my friends accept me again? Tell me the treaty is recovered and my long suffering is over.
"I only found this strange object."
You found a strangeness? I cannot see it. You are so far away and my eyes are so very, very small.
[Raise the object higher.]
Oh. That. The Not-so-Grand Carnival used this catalyst to bind me here and sever their sight of me, since destroying me is impossible.
I didn't want to kill them, but they needed to die. They took so very, very long.
I know YOU understand.
"What are you...?"
Hu hu hu hu hu.
"If it hurts, you should stop."
That's what the graves want me to do. But I see their game. Oh ho ho, ohhhh how I see their game. In the past they tried to snub me. Ever been to Brightwood?
"Yes, but it's been a while."
Those are some cold-shoulder graves. Never acknowledged me... But in this region -- and this is embarrassing -- the graves actually leave ME flowers. So romantic!
"I don't think those are for you…"
Listen. I'm about all finished up here and moving on. You look like a person who does not know the undiluted joy of desecra-- DIGGING. And the profit of Gravedirt.
"Really... 'dirt'...?"
No! It's not dirt, it's Dirt! Nighthaven is steaming with that luscious loam. You'll find it very useful for alchemy. Keep any. My pockets are already full to bursting.
I admit the remaining spoils will be paltry. But you're welcome to anything I missed in my delirium.
Complete the Quest
Is it done? Tell me how it went! Were they very nice graves? Are they eager for my return? Are any of them, like, you know, seeing any... other... gravediggers?
"Found fancy coins and all that dirt."
Ohh how I envy you. You've taken the first of many steps into the wonderful world of victimless cri-- ADVENTURE.
"Thanks. Is this map useful to you?"
Let me see... Oh. OH! Are these...? they ARE! The Builder King's Secret Catacombs. The graves would never divulge these to me, but they told you? JEALOUSY.
Keep your shovel. Mine is better. And I will... hmmm, need to burrow through a couple hills to get where this is pointing-- WAIT. Which side is NORTH?
"Wait... you have?"

resources.string: I... think so, yes. Yes. You can help where no one else can, find what no one else can find. We've waited for someone with your ability for so long.
"Who is 'we'?"

string.direction: She is attempting to assert her identity in this line. Should be a little more forceful.

resources.string: I'm sorry... I mean me, Eliza Ellingwood - I'VE waited for so long for help. Have you seen the strange statues? The ones holding blue torches?
"Maybe. What about them?"

resources.string: They aren't just statues. They hold... something. A piece of something, like a soul. That flame is the power of the soul, waiting to be reunited.
"Reunited with what?"

resources.string: With... something. I'm sorry, my thoughts are... fuzzy. Can you collect some of the soul fragments and bring them here? I might understand more if you do.
"Where can I find them?"

resources.string: Anywhere? Everywhere. I'm sorry, but you'll have to search high and low. Like much of Nighthaven, I think they're meant to stay hidden.

resources.string: The statues are spread all over Nighthaven. I wish I had better directions, but that's all I know.
Complete the Quest
Oh... you've... you've found some! That is fantastic! I can... feel them.
"Feel them? How?"
A pull... a voice? It's not important right now. But you've earned a reward for your help. Thank you for finding these!
"You'd like me to find more."

string.direction: She seems a bit confused, but it is clearing up.
string.context: She is hearing the Builder King's voice a bit clearer now.
string.speaker: Eliza Ellingwood
string.name: ElizaEllingwood

resources.string: I... yes. If you would lend your help again. I can hear... a voice. Something that was silent is growing louder.
"Are you certain this is safe?"
...yes? I don't know. I think so. I don't hear malice in the whisper, but without more fragments I can't be sure.
"So you're hearing a voice in your head?"
More like... feeling it. I know, it's a bit difficult to explain, let alone understand. Please, find more fragments, and maybe I can figure out what's going on.
The statues are spread all over Nighthaven. I wish I had better directions, but that's all I know.
Complete the Quest
Soulwarden! I knew you were coming back! You've found more, haven't you?
"I did. They were well hidden."
It's as I thought - someone does not want these found. But we knew you'd be able to see through the shadow, seeing what you've accomplished here already.
"You keep saying 'we'."
I... I know. That voice I can hear... or feel? It's not just in my head. It's like... it's like it is all of me.
"That doesn't sound good."
I know. I know it doesn't. But as I said before, I don't feel any malice. I don't feel like it means me harm. Just that it... wants to speak.
"And the fragments are how it will?"
I think so, yes. Each time you bring me more, the voice -- the feeling -- gets more and more clear. I think we're doing the right thing.
"All right, if you say so."
For now, let's focus on collecting the rest of the fragments. As before, they could be anywhere, so please... keep checking the hidden places of Nighthaven.
I will let you know if I feel any threat coming from the voice that I'm hearing. In the meantime, let's keep looking for the fragments.
Complete the Quest
You... Soulwarden. You are the one who collected my soul fragments, are you not?
"I was, yes. Who are you?"
I remember little. I know that I am in Durevos, and that I once called this place home, but my memory is fragmented, much like my soul was.
"Durevos? You mean Nighthaven?"
Nighthaven? How long has it been since... no matter. I have much to relearn since I... passed. But you should be rewarded for helping me.
The chamber behind me carries treasures of old. I have no further use of them, although I feel they will aid you in your journeys. The chamber is now open to you.
"What about Eliza?"
Eliza... yes. She was my voice when I had none to use. I have released her, and her mind is once more her own. For now, farewell to you, Soulwarden. Perhaps we will speak again one day.
"Greetings, doctor. You look troubled."
Something is wrong with the Berlaur... more than an airborne contagion! I sent poor Ejnar to Madmaw Furrow -- brilliant boy, brittle mind. If the soil whispered, he may have listened too closely.
"What is Madmaw Furrow?"

Just south of here, a grove of massive trees. The beasts homestead there. I wouldn't recommend visiting, but if you do... keep an eye out for signs of the boy. He has yet to return. If you find anything, I can reward you.
Poor Ejnar, always too eager to find solutions, risky experimentation. Foolhardy boy. Flighty as a raven and less dependable.
Complete the Quest
You tracked down his journals you say? I'll have to look through these. The boy may yet be alive. You have my thanks.
"Always a pleasure, Doctor."

Thank you for tracking down Ejnar's notes. He has been a good apprentice for a long while. The fool took it upon himself to establish a quarantine for the beasts at Piatra. I worry he has gone too far in an attempt get my approval.
The search for my apprentice must be arduous indeed. I hope to hear good news soon.
"I'll track him down!"

Many thanks, my friend. Do what you can. When you find the lad, tell him he was dumber than a labrador. Going off on a fool's quest when he barely knows his acids from his bases. He's bound to make a grievous mistake.
Complete the Quest
Ah well. That is disappointing. In the end I suppose this work is not fit for an apprentice. That much is certain.
